guidance.statement: Management stays committed to maintaining an EBITDA margin corridor despite raw material inflation.
guidance.quote: we have guided a corridor of 20% to 24%. We stay committed to that guidance.

guidance.statement: Capital expenditure is expected to remain within the historical range of revenue turnover.
guidance.quote: Our capex tends to be actually 3% to 5% of our revenue turnover... I think we'll remain in that band.

guidance.statement: The company aims to systematically raise underlying volume growth year-on-year.
guidance.quote: our desire and our planning is to, therefore, keep raising this systematically... delivering double-digit underlying volume growth

achieved.claim: Delivered 15.3% underlying volume growth in Q4 FY26.
Consolidated revenue reached INR 14,553 crores for the full year FY26.
EBITDA margin expanded by 310 basis points in the current quarter.
Full year FY26 underlying volume growth improved by 120 basis points over FY25.

pushback.concern: Whether the 15% volume growth included one-offs or trade channel loading before price hikes.
The impact of significant price hikes on future volume demand elasticity.
Lack of a clear USP or right to win in the competitive paints segment.
The strategic rationale behind swapping BuildNext for an insignificant stake in JSW One.

output.tone_why: Management balances strong current performance with caution regarding West Asia conflict and raw material inflation.
